description: Abstract class for service engine implementations in the Apache OFBiz framework, managing service location mappings and callback dispatching.

classes.name: AbstractEngine
classes.description: Abstract class implementing core service engine functionalities, including location mapping and callback handling.

methods.name: getDispatcher
methods.description: Returns the ServiceDispatcher instance associated with this engine.

methods.name: createLocationMap
methods.description: Creates an immutable map of service location aliases from configuration.

methods.name: getLocation
methods.description: Retrieves the actual service implementation location, considering aliases.

methods.name: sendCallbacks
methods.description: Overloaded methods to send callback events to registered listeners, with optional exception or result data.

methods.name: allowCallbacks
methods.description: Determines whether callbacks are permitted; default implementation always allows.
